The '''Burning Plains Bridge''' was a bridge located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. It was built by the [[Klegger Corporation]] long before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to connect the [[Smoking Forest/Legends|Smoking Forest]] region to the [[Burning Plains/Legends|Burning Plains]].<ref name="SWG:TSFM" /> The bridge was originally formed out of steel but years in the harsh Mustafarian environment had coated it with volcanic ash and rock so that it resembled a natural rock formation by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TCFM">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Crystal Flats Markers|Mustafar}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer visited the area and collected [[the Silencer]] pistol under the bridge.<ref name="SWG:RPWMIII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Pistol Weapons Mark III}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Burning Plains Bridge was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TSFM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Burning Plains Bridge was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TSFM" />
